params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, {{ci|Rakan}} generates a {{tip|shield}} that regenerates out of combat if not broken.
params.blurb2: '''Rakan's''' basic attacks and ability hits against enemy {{tip|champions}} {{sti|ah|reduce}} this ability's cooldown.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Innate - Lover's Leap:}} '''Rakan''' and {{ci|Xayah}} may {{si|recall|Recall}} together by {{tip|channel|channeling}} their ''Recalls'' beside each other.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Rakan''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{pp|30 + (225-30)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ 95% AP)}} that lasts until broken. After being [[out of combat]] for 5 seconds, any leftover shield will be restored to '''maximum''' value.
params.description2: '''Rakan's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} <!--{{tip|on-attack}}?--> and {{tip|ability}} hits reduce ''Fey Feathers' '' {{sti|cooldown}} by 1 second for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit.
params.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Lover's Leap:}} If either '''Rakan''' or {{ci|Xayah}} is channeling {{si|Recall}}, the other may move nearby and channel their own to join alongside them. '''Both''' reach base at the time of which the initiator's {{si|Recall}} completes.
params.cooldown: {{pp|40 to 14.5 for 18; then -0.875*x for 2|formula=40 - 1.5 * level until level 18, then -0.875 per level}}
params.notes:
* {{ri|Revitalize}} will record bonus shielding when a new shield is created, but not when it regenerates. In either case, there is no bonus shielding received.
* The cooldown reduction is granted even if the ability is blocked by a {{tip|spell shield}} or {{ai|Riposte|Fiora}}.
* The cooldown reduction is granted even if the attack is {{tip|blocked}}, {{tip|dodged}}, or misses due to {{tip|blind}}.

blurb.plain: Innate: Periodically, Rakan generates a shield that regenerates out of combat if not broken.

blurb2.plain: Rakan's basic attacks and ability hits against enemy champions reduce this ability's cooldown.

blurb3.plain: Innate - Lover's Leap: Rakan and Xayah may recall together by channeling their Recalls beside each other.

description.plain: Innate: Periodically, Rakan grants himself a shield for ⟦pp⟧ (+ 95% AP) that lasts until broken. After being out of combat for 5 seconds, any leftover shield will be restored to maximum value.

description2.plain: Rakan's basic attacks and ability hits reduce Fey Feathers' cooldown by 1 second for each enemy champion hit.

description3.plain: Innate - Lover's Leap: If either Rakan or Xayah is channeling Recall, the other may move nearby and channel their own to join alongside them. Both reach base at the time of which the initiator's Recall completes.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Rakan}} slings an enchanted feather in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit.
params.blurb2: If the feather hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} or epic {{tip|monster}}, '''Rakan''' winds up a circular mark around him over a few seconds. When the mark completes, Rakan {{tip|heal|heals}} himself.
params.blurb3: If '''Rakan''' collides with an allied champion, the mark instantly completes to grant an increased heal to all champions within the circle.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rakan''' slings an enchanted feather in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit.
params.description2: If the target was an enemy {{tip|champion}} or epic {{tip|monster}}, a radius is marked around '''Rakan'''. After 3 seconds or if an allied champion enters the radius, '''Rakan''' {{tip|heals}} himself and nearby allied champions for {{pp|40 + (210-40)*(x-1)/17|1 to 20 by 1|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}.
params.notes:
* The trigger radius is slightly smaller than the heal radius.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent the marked area from being formed.
* The heal can activate immediately after the projectile hits the target, before the healing return animation completes.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* The heal will trigger and affect '''Rakan''' even if he is {{tip|untargetable}}.

blurb.plain: Active: Rakan slings an enchanted feather in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit.

blurb2.plain: If the feather hits an enemy champion or epic monster, Rakan winds up a circular mark around him over a few seconds. When the mark completes, Rakan heals himself.

blurb3.plain: If Rakan collides with an allied champion, the mark instantly completes to grant an increased heal to all champions within the circle.

description.plain: Active: Rakan slings an enchanted feather in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit.

description2.plain: If the target was an enemy champion or epic monster, a radius is marked around Rakan. After 3 seconds or if an allied champion enters the radius, Rakan heals himself and nearby allied champions for ⟦pp⟧ (+ 55% AP).

params.blurb2: After a brief delay, he deals {{as|magic damage}} and briefly {{tip|airborne|knocks up}} nearby enemies.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rakan''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location. After a {{fd|0.35}}-second delay upon arrival, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for 1 second.
params.description2: '''''Rakan''' will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash.''
params.notes:
* ''Grand Entrance'' has no minimum dash range.
* {{tip|Sleep}} does not count for knocking the dash down.{{bug}}

blurb.plain: Active: Rakan dashes to the target location.

blurb2.plain: After a brief delay, he deals magic damage and briefly knocks up nearby enemies.

description.plain: Active: Rakan dashes to the target location. After a 0.35-second delay upon arrival, he deals magic damage to nearby enemies and knocks them up for 1 second.

description2.plain: Rakan will be knocked down by any immobilizing or polymorphing crowd control during the dash.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Rakan}} can cast or re-cast ''Battle Dance'' at an increased {{sti|range}} when targeting {{ci|Xayah}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rakan''' {{tip|shield|shields}} the target allied champion for a short time, then {{tip|dash|dashes}} to them. ''Battle Dance'' can be recast once with no cost.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rakan''' grants a {{tip|shield}} to the target allied champion for 3 seconds and then {{tip|dash|dashes}} to and around them. ''Battle Dance'' can be recast within 5 seconds at no additional cost.
params.description3: '''''Rakan''' will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash.''
params.description4: ''If {{ci|Xayah}} is the target, Battle Dance can be cast from an increased range.''
params.notes:
* Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* The shields do not stack if ''Battle Dance'' is cast on the same target twice. Only the duration and shield amount is refreshed.
* ''Battle Dance'', its recast, and its empowered version on {{ci|Xayah}} all have a {{tip|forgiveness radius}} of 175 units. 
* {{tip|Sleep}} does not count for knocking the dash down.{{bug}}

blurb.plain: Passive: Rakan can cast or re-cast Battle Dance at an increased range when targeting Xayah.

blurb2.plain: Active: Rakan shields the target allied champion for a short time, then dashes to them. Battle Dance can be recast once with no cost.

blurb3.plain: Recast: Rakan mimics the first cast.

description.plain: Active: Rakan grants a shield to the target allied champion for 3 seconds and then dashes to and around them. Battle Dance can be recast within 5 seconds at no additional cost.

description2.plain: Recast: Rakan mimics the first cast's effects.

description3.plain: Rakan will be knocked down by any immobilizing or polymorphing crowd control during the dash.

description4.plain: If Xayah is the target, Battle Dance can be cast from an increased range.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Rakan}} breaks into a captivating sprint, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a few seconds. '''Rakan''' deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies he touches, briefly {{tip|charm|charming}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them.
params.blurb2: Unique enemy {{tip|champion}} collisions slightly extend ''The Quickness' ''duration. The first enemy {{tip|champion|champion}} '''Rakan''' touches also grants him a burst of {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rakan''' breaks into a captivating sprint for 4 seconds, gaining {{tip|ghosting}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|75% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for the duration. During this time, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies he collides with and {{tip|charm|charms}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 75% for a duration. This cannot affect the same enemy more than once.

blurb.plain: Active: Rakan breaks into a captivating sprint, becoming ghosted and gaining bonus movement speed for a few seconds. Rakan deals magic damage to enemies he touches, briefly charming and slowing them.

blurb2.plain: Unique enemy champion collisions slightly extend The Quickness' duration. The first enemy champion Rakan touches also grants him a burst of bonus movement speed.

description.plain: Active: Rakan breaks into a captivating sprint for 4 seconds, gaining ghosting and 75% bonus movement speed for the duration. During this time, he deals magic damage to enemies he collides with and charms and slows them by 75% for a duration. This cannot affect the same enemy more than once.

description2.plain: Colliding with an enemy champion extends The Quickness' duration by 0.25 seconds, which can occur once per champion. When Rakan collides with his first enemy champion, he gains an additional 75% bonus movement speed that decays after 0.5 seconds by 20% every 0.5 seconds, then by 15% after decaying by 60% over 1.5 seconds.

description4.plain: During The Quickness, Rakan cannot basic attack enemy champions he did not collide with, unless the attack command was inputted before the ability was activated.
